integrity: The proof uses the source's exact section equations and lattice formula sigma=3-m, followed by a complete algebraic elimination of the common-root parameter. The decisive substitution identity is replayable symbolically; no finite experiment is used as an infinite-field proof.
scientific_limitations: The stratification is stated in the vector-field coefficient presentation of the multiplicative construction; it does not identify a global coarse-moduli quotient, classify the source's abstract Picard overlattices, or treat the additive group-scheme branch.
title: Exact Artin-invariant jumping locus in the multiplicative cuspidal Kummer family
